displayName: Build a one-page candidate brief for the hiring manager
summary: Give your hiring manager a clean brief on any candidate in seconds.

useCases.title: Build a one-page candidate brief for the hiring manager
useCases.message: Help me brief a hiring manager on a candidate. Ask me who the candidate is and which role they're being considered for. If you don't already know which ATS I use, ask. Then pull their LinkedIn profile and their application from my ATS, and write a clean one-page summary covering their background, fit, and any areas to explore.
